ios:us:6761419783.name: Word Jam - Screw Puzzle
ios:us:6761419783.description:
Get ready to twist, turn, and spell your way to victory in Word Jam – Screw Puzzle! This dynamic new word–physics hybrid challenges your mind with a fresh blend of vocabulary mastery and mechanical strategy.
How to Play
Analyze: Study the target word and locate the letters hidden across layered mechanical boards. Twist: Tap to remove screws, trigger chain reactions, and use physics to shift panels out of your way. Collect: Gather each letter in the correct order to complete the word and clear the level. Survive: Stay organized! Prevent layers from stacking too high and enjoy the satisfying “Victory Wave” as the boards collapse.
Why You’ll Love Word Jam – Screw Puzzle
	•	Dynamic Multi-Layer Frames: Begin with two layers and unlock up to four as puzzles grow more complex.
	•	Tactile Physics Engine: Feel every movement with realistic board sway, collisions, and high-quality haptic feedback.
	•	Vivid 2D Mazes: Navigate through striking, color-coded layers designed to be both visually stunning and strategically deep.
	•	Brain-Boosting Gameplay: Strengthen vocabulary, spatial reasoning, and problem-solving skills—all in one unique puzzle experience.
Dive into Word Jam – Screw Puzzle, where mechanical puzzles meet clever wordplay. Download now and enjoy a visually rich, mentally stimulating adventure!

android:tw.idv.ananshop.i3dBrick.name: 3d Brick Breaker
android:tw.idv.ananshop.i3dBrick.description:
3D Brick Breaker takes the classic bounce-the-ball arcade game into a starry 3D arena. A perspective board with a glass floor and glowing neon walls gives every shot real weight: bricks shudder when hit and burst into flying shards, and the ball rings off walls and paddle alike.
1000 levels across 20 themed worlds bring steel, crystal and explosive bricks, portals, switch gates, poison clouds and lava. Every 10th level is a golden bonus stage, every 20th pits you against a boss, and every 50th is a race against the clock. Twelve power-ups, from multi-ball and lasers to shields and magnets, keep each run fresh. The longer your combo, the higher your score multiplier, and a 30-hit streak unleashes FEVER mode.
Above the board, the Milky Way glows, meteors streak by, the twelve zodiac constellations shine and star warships cruise past. Spend your coins on lasting upgrades, test your nerve in Endless Mode, collect achievements, and climb the Google Play Games world rankings. Every clear is celebrated with fireworks, streamers and an original soundtrack.
Play with swipe, an on-screen joystick or tilt, or pick up a TV remote, a keyboard or a gamepad. Folding, unfolding or turning your device pauses the game safely, and your best score and best level are kept even if you leave in the middle of a run. It runs on phones, tablets, foldables and Android TV, in 51 languages, with no ads.

ios:us:6761043541.name: Last Beacon: Survival
ios:us:6761043541.description:

Your leadership will determine success or failure.
In this new era, endless possibilities await!

Build Ocean Shelters

Exploration & Combat

Alliances & Sea Dominance

Deep-Sea Crises
Survive sudden disasters, colossal sea monsters, and ruthless pirates threatening your existence.

android:com.pointaway.gp.name: Point Away 3D: Cube Puzzle
android:com.pointaway.gp.description:
A crowded 3D shape can hide one clean solution.

Point Away 3D: Cube Puzzle is a spatial logic game about observation, rotation, and finding the right order. Turn the model to inspect every side, trace each arrow’s direction, and discover which routes are open.

Tap an arrow with a clear path to send it away. Every arrow you remove can reveal new options, turning a complex shape into a satisfying chain of solutions.

HOW TO PLAY

• Swipe to rotate the 3D model.
• Study the direction and path of each arrow.
• Tap arrows that have a clear route.
• Remove them in the right order.
• Clear every arrow to complete the puzzle.

EXPLORE EVERY ANGLE

The answer may be hidden on the back, underneath the shape, or across another face. Rotate freely and examine the full model before making your next move.

MORE THAN CUBES

Begin with familiar cube puzzles, then encounter rectangular models and distinctive 3D shapes. Cross-face arrows, layered paths, and denser layouts create new challenges without changing the simple core rules.

A SATISFYING DIFFICULTY CURVE

Early levels make the rules easy to understand. As you progress, puzzles introduce more arrows, longer dependency chains, fewer immediate options, and shapes that require careful inspection.

WHY YOU’LL ENJOY IT

• Simple controls with smooth 3D rotation
• Clear, readable arrow layouts
• Satisfying removal effects
• Cubes, rectangular models, and special shapes
• Logic-based challenges with increasing depth
• Quick levels for short breaks and tougher puzzles for focused play

Rotate the shape. Read the paths. Find the order.

Download Point Away 3D: Cube Puzzle and clear every arrow.

android:com.sort.solitairegoddess.card.g.name: Solitaire Goddess: Card Sort
android:com.sort.solitairegoddess.card.g.description:
Welcome to Solitaire Goddess: Card Sort, a fresh take on classic solitaire that turns every card into a colorful picture puzzle 🃏!

Forget traditional card suits and number matching. Here, your goal is to sort image cards into the correct category cards and clear the tableau 🧩. Observe each picture, find its category, and plan your moves carefully to complete every level 🧠.

HOW TO PLAY 🎮

• View the image cards on the tableau 🖼️.

• Identify what category each picture belongs to 🔍.

• Move image cards onto the correct category cards 🃏.

• Sort cards strategically to uncover new options 🧠.

• Clear the tableau to complete the level ✨.

• Complete levels to unlock beautiful character artwork and videos 🎨.

A NEW KIND OF SOLITAIRE 🌟

Solitaire Goddess: Card Sort combines the familiar satisfaction of solitaire with the visual fun of picture classification 🧩. Instead of matching suits, you will organize images by category. Every level offers a new arrangement and a fresh sorting challenge, making the game easy to learn but rewarding to master 🎮.

SORT, THINK, AND CLEAR 🧠

Look closely at every image and consider the best order for your moves 🔍. Some cards may be hidden beneath others, so careful planning is the key to revealing the tableau. Sort efficiently, make smart decisions, and enjoy the satisfying feeling of clearing the board one card at a time ✨.

UNLOCK BEAUTIFUL CHARACTERS 🎨

Complete levels to unlock gorgeous character illustrations and videos 💖. Discover new visual content as you progress and experience memorable moments that make your journey more rewarding 🌟. Each achievement brings you closer to the next beautiful character experience ✨.

DISCOVER MORE IMAGE CATEGORIES 🖼️

As you level up, more image categories and picture cards will gradually unlock 📈. Keep playing to discover new images and take on fresh sorting challenges 🧩. Every unlock represents your progress and gives you a new goal to look forward to 🌟.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE SOLITAIRE GODDESS: CARD SORT 💖

• A creative picture-sorting twist on classic solitaire 🃏.

• No traditional suit matching—sort cards by image category 🧩.

• Easy-to-learn rules with satisfying puzzle depth 🎮.

• Colorful image cards and varied sorting challenges 🖼️.

• Beautiful character illustrations and videos to unlock 🎨.

• New images and challenges to discover as you level up 📈.

• Relaxing gameplay that you can enjoy at your own pace 😌.

Take a break, sharpen your observation skills, and enjoy a new solitaire adventure 😌. Sort the pictures, clear the cards, unlock beautiful characters, and discover the goddess world waiting for you in Solitaire Goddess: Card Sort ✨!

Factifact is a trivia word puzzle that turns fun facts into wordplay. 🔍 Each short fact hides some of its words inside brackets. Read the definitions, find the missing words and reveal the whole fact.

Every word you find brings you closer to interesting facts about the world. 🧠 Think of them as word riddles that test your vocabulary.
 
Factifact works like a reverse crossword without a grid. ⛏️ Classic crossword puzzles give you a clue and a row of empty squares. Here you start from the clue and dig down to the hidden word. Fans of word puzzle games will feel at home right away. Every brainteaser blends vocabulary, reasoning and general knowledge in one sequence. Short brain teasers like these make a calm mental workout at any time.
 
Guess the word correctly and the next layer of the puzzle opens. Unlike most word quiz games, every answer becomes part of the next clue. These trivia questions reward careful reading and patient thinking. Solving puzzles here feels like piecing a small story together. What you will find inside:
💡 A hint when a clue feels too tricky
❤️ Three hearts per fact, so every guess counts
🏺 A dig site that uncovers a hidden find with each solved word
📌 A board where every solved fact is pinned as a colorful note
🎉 Confetti, fireworks and kind words when a fact is fully revealed
 
The facts cover nature, geography, animals and much more. 🏺 One puzzle explains why honey can stay fresh for centuries. Another shows how Mount Everest is still growing. If you enjoy crossword puzzles, these little discoveries will surprise you. Factifact brings word puzzle games and general knowledge together. Expect brain teasers that are short, fair and satisfying to crack.
 
Facts unlock one after another, and any solved fact can be reread later. 📌 Some logic puzzles are gentle, while others are real brainteasers with deep nesting. A wrong answer costs a heart, so read each clue carefully. Love word quiz games, solving puzzles and interesting facts? 🎉 Factifact is waiting for you.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🧩 HOW IT WORKS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🏆 LEVEL PROGRESSION

▸ Level 1 - Apprentice
7x7 grid with 7 markers. Learn the game mechanics at your own pace.

▸ Level 2 - Explorer
7x7 grid with more walls and more complex routes. The challenge begins to grow.

▸ Level 3 - Strategist
8x8 grid with 8 markers. New spatial challenges require more planning.

▸ Level 4 - Master
8x8 grid with advanced asymmetrical walls. Only the most persistent reach this point.

▸ Level 5 - Legendary
The pinnacle of the game. Elaborate puzzles for those who have mastered everything that came before.

Each level has 10 stages with 5 puzzles each - 50 challenges per level, 250 in total.

android:com.kiwigames.packthemess.find.s.description:
Welcome to Pack the Mess – the cozy puzzle where every messy room is waiting to be packed!

HOW TO PLAY

• Items without a matching box wait in the holding tray. When the right box shows up, they jump in on their own.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT

Whether you love hidden object games, sorting puzzles, or just the joy of turning chaos into order, Pack the Mess is your new favorite way to unwind.

Grab a box and start packing the mess today!

android:com.game.dropcolorblocks.name: Topplewood
android:com.game.dropcolorblocks.description:
Topplewood is a physics puzzle game where precision and sequence determine every outcome. Tap to release suspended wooden parts, trigger chain reactions, and assemble complete figures step by step.

Study the target silhouette at the top of the screen and examine the wooden pieces on the board. Each tap releases an item into dynamic motion: parts tumble down slides, tip balance beams, rebound off bouncy surfaces, and push neighboring blocks. One wrong move or fallen block resets the puzzle, making careful planning and spatial reasoning essential.

Gameplay Features:
• Sequence-Driven Puzzles: Planning and order decide everything. Shapes only come together when parts fall in the single correct succession.
• Dynamic Physics: Navigate realistic interactions with ramps, seesaws, rolling balls, and counterweights that redirect falling parts.
• Layered Objects: Uncover nested components and overlapping layers, requiring you to release outer pieces before reaching the interior.
• Helpful Hints: Activate the hint booster to instantly highlight the next correct piece in the sequence when you need guidance.
• Tactile Wooden Aesthetic: Enjoy detailed wood grain textures, responsive motion, and natural physics designed for relaxing visual clarity.
• No Time Pressure: Solve short, focused levels at your own pace with intuitive one-tap controls.

Plan each drop, trigger balanced reactions, and complete every figure in Topplewood!
